name: Choreographd
tagline: Choreographd provides a way for solo founders to effectively organize their work
description: Choreographd provides a way for solo founders to effectively organize their work. We help you figure out what to do next while managing context switching - from analytics, to marketing, to software development, and back again. Choreographd was built with practical usage in mind, using tried-and-true methodology from top VCs, YC alum, and successful founders.
